title: Record search
summary: Staff, volunteers and students can find pets, tickets, cases, consultations, users and applications from Ctrl+K and plugin list filters, with group-scoped results.
changes: Ctrl+K searches live records (pets, tickets, cases, consultations, users, applications) through a debounced JSON endpoint, with typed groups and keyboard navigation.
Each plugin contributes a RecordSearch provider that reuses view-all/view-own and per-group access from the list pages.
Exact reference or microchip matches rank first; status filters are supported on search and list pages.
Plugin index pages gain accessible query-string filter bars for search, status, assignee and dates.
Additive, reversible search indexes (MySQL FULLTEXT where supported; plain indexes for SQLite CI) and an optional pet microchip field.
affected_areas: Tickets, pets, cases, consultations and recruitment application lists
User and client profile deep links
version_rationale: Minor: new record-search capability for staff-side workspace users without breaking existing palette navigation or list routes.
validation: RecordSearchTest (7 tests) and command-palette.test.js green locally.
Herd preview gate on BM-OMEN-HOMEPC; migrations applied including search indexes.
known_limitations: Record search returns at most five hits per type in the palette; full filtering remains on plugin list pages.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag. New search indexes and the optional pet microchip column are additive and reversible.
provenance: Milestone epic #526 and pull request #856 on the milestone/v0-67-0-record-search branch.
